## Social Media as News

Authors: Anna-Lies Voorham and Lillie Perez



## Project Description

We will be researching how people, particularly young people, use social media as their main source of news.

## Research Questions

Our main research questions are:

- Are young people more likely to use social media as their main source of news?
- Hace the rates of people using social media as their main source of news increased over time?
